approved.appearance: Color the full card with the approved static badge fills: success #CDEBD7, warning #FFF1BD, danger #FFD6CC. Text and 1px card outline #131210. IBM Plex Sans; title 12/600, detail 11/500. The 18px sign has no surrounding border. No new hue or page-local lookalike.
approved.geometry: One compact card at a time, fixed at the upper right: 16px viewport inset, maximum 420px width; 8px inset on screens up to 480px. Card padding 11px 12px, 10px content gap, 22px close target and system focus ring.
approved.behavior: Slide down from above; each card starts its own 5-second timer when it becomes visible, then closes. The close button removes it immediately. Other messages wait in FIFO order; notifications never move page content. Respect reduced-motion preference.
approved.accessibility: Errors use role=alert; success and warning use role=status. The close button is a native button labelled Закрыть уведомление with visible keyboard focus.
approved.boundary: Field-specific validation errors and durable configuration/blocking alerts remain beside the relevant control or in the page; only transient operation results move to the notification center. Existing MAX settings toasts keep their previous opt-in appearance and timeout until separately adapted.
